newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian retail sales grew 1.8 pct in March yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italian retail sales grew 1.8 pct in March yr/yr.

text.p: Retail sales of medium and large firms in Italy rose 1.8 percent in March 1997 compared with a year earlier, national statistics institute ISTAT said.
Istat said the retail sales index (1995=100) stood at 103.4 in March against 101.6 in the same month last year.
In the first three months of the year, retail sales grew 1.5 percent, Istat said.
The March increase included a 3.0 percent increase in sales at major distribution centres. Smaller outlets registered a 1.5 percent increase in sales.
The value of food sales rose 2.2 percent in March while non-food sales rose 1.5 percent.
